secondary.name: PFS
secondary.cohorts: only where the raw GEO records provide PFS; extracted with the step 2a inclusion rules; coding checked before any PFS analysis

features.standardization: gene-wise z-score with the mean and SD (ddof=1) of the training data of the current fit

model.type: Cox proportional hazards with elastic-net penalty
model.cv_criterion: cross-validated partial-likelihood deviance (Verweij and van Houwelingen 1993; grouped, as in glmnet)
model.numerical_failure_rule: penalty values at which any fold fails are dropped for all folds; reported
model.empty_model_rule: reported as a null result; settings are not changed to force genes into the model
model.grid_boundary_rule: if lambda_min is the smallest penalty on the grid, this is reported; the grid is not extended
model.risk_score: linear predictor LP = sum over selected genes of beta_g * z_g

risk_groups.primary_cutoff: median LP of the training set; high vs low
risk_groups.external_cutoff: median LP of each external cohort

nested_cv.metric: Harrell's C in each outer test fold
nested_cv.cv_km: repeat 1; each outer test fold split at the median LP of its outer training fold

step4_training.added_value_descriptive: out-of-fold LP (repeat 1, standardized with the LP mean and SD of its outer training fold) added to Cox(IPI + COO) in IPI complete cases; LRT and delta C

stability_bootstrap.penalty: fixed at lambda_min of the final model

sensitivity.a_lambda_1se: same CV as the primary model

b_pure_lasso.nested_cv: 5-fold x 1 repeat, same folds as primary repeat 1

c_no_variance_filter.nested_cv: 5-fold x 1 repeat, same folds as primary repeat 1

reported: Jaccard overlap with the primary model

step5_internal_validation.precondition: SHA-256 of the frozen model recorded in manifest_04b.json
step5_internal_validation.test_scaling_sensitivity: z-score within the test set (primary population)
step5_internal_validation.primary_metric: Cox HR per 1 SD of LP (SD of the cohort's own LP) with 95% CI
other_metrics: Uno's C truncated at tau (endpoints: uno_c_tau_months, uno_c_min_at_risk_fraction)
Kaplan-Meier high vs low risk (training cutoff), log-rank test, HR high vs low
calibration slope (Cox coefficient of the raw LP)
step5_internal_validation.H1: HR per SD > 1 with 95% CI excluding 1 (two-sided alpha = 0.05)

step5_negative_control.permutation: (time, event) pairs permuted jointly among the primary training patients
step5_negative_control.procedure: full pipeline of plan sections 4-5, including CV for the penalty, re-run on each permutation
step5_negative_control.evaluation: C-index on the true test labels
report: mean and 2.5-97.5 percentiles of permuted test C
empirical p = (1 + number of permuted C >= observed C) / (1 + n_permutations)

step6_external_validation.transfer: frozen Entrez IDs and coefficients; no re-selection, re-fitting or re-tuning
step6_external_validation.scaling: gene-wise z-score within each cohort, computed on its primary analysis population
step6_external_validation.not_transferred: absolute scale: baseline hazard and numeric LP cutoff
step6_external_validation.H2: per cohort: HR per SD > 1 with 95% CI excluding 1; GSE10846 main, GSE87371 supportive
step6_external_validation.sensitivity_scaling: scores of the primary analysis; no re-scaling

benchmarks: COO (GCB reference; ABC; other = UNC, MHG or unclassified)
step7_clinical_comparison.H3: likelihood-ratio test (1 df), Cox(IPI + COO) vs Cox(IPI + COO + LP per SD); primary in the test set, p < 0.05
also_reported: adjusted HR per SD with 95% CI
delta Harrell's C with 95% bootstrap CI (both models refitted in each resample)
step7_clinical_comparison.delta_c_note: combination weights are fitted in the same cohort, which slightly favours the larger model; the likelihood-ratio test accounts for the extra parameter
step7_clinical_comparison.coo_sensitivity: GSE181063: MHG as a separate category
step7_clinical_comparison.descriptive: C-index of IPI, COO and LP alone and combined, in the same complete-case subset

conclusion_rules.externally_validated: H2 met in GSE10846 and HR > 1 in GSE87371
conclusion_rules.adds_information_beyond_ipi_and_coo: H3 met in the test set and adjusted HR > 1 in both external cohorts
conclusion_rules.otherwise: reported as negative or inconclusive, with the same detail

red_flags: test-set C exceeds the nested-CV mean C by more than 0.10
multiplicity: H1 is the only primary hypothesis; all other tests are secondary, unadjusted and supportive

step4_uses: training rows of clinical_clean_all.csv (other rows dropped right after loading)
data_access.test_set_opened_in: step 5, after the frozen model hash is recorded

deviations.policy: locked files are never edited; changes are appended with date, reason and data seen; after the test set is opened only error corrections are allowed and both the original and the corrected results are reported
